About.heroTitle: Built by people who understand Africa's operators
About.heroSubtitle: OpDesk exists because running a safari lodge, a shuttle fleet, or a fishing charter shouldn't mean juggling five different spreadsheets and a WhatsApp group.
About.why1: Most operations software is built for hotels in Europe or tour companies in the US — it doesn't understand firearm registers, multi-currency invoicing across a dozen African currencies, or the difference between a game vehicle and a shuttle van.
About.why2: OpDesk is built specifically for the operators who keep Africa's tourism industry running: safari lodges, guesthouses, shuttle and transfer companies, fishing and yacht charters, trail guiding operations, and the logistics and support businesses that keep them supplied. One dashboard for bookings, staff, fleet, lodging, certifications, and invoicing — in the currency and language you actually work in.
About.why3: No credit card required to start. No lock-in. Just a tool that gets out of your way so you can run your business.
About.whoSubheading: If this sounds like your business, OpDesk was built for you
About.ctaSubheading: Join operators across Africa who run their business with OpDesk.
About.metaDescription: OpDesk is built for Africa's travel and hospitality operators — by a team that understands the continent's currencies, languages, and compliance needs.

hero.title: Every feature your operation actually needs

bookings-calendar.title: Bookings & Calendar
bookings-calendar.desc: Create and manage bookings across tours, transfers, charters and stays, with guest details, pricing, and status tracking in one place.

fleet-management.desc: Track every vehicle and vessel — registration, capacity, and status — so you always know what's available and what's in for maintenance.

guest-directory.title: Guest Directory

invoicing.title: Pro Forma & Tax Invoices

reports-analytics.title: Reports & Analytics
reports-analytics.desc: Occupancy, revenue, staff cost and booking trend reports whenever you need them.

multi-currency.title: Multi-Currency & Language

white-label-branding.desc: Put your own logo and colours on guest-facing invoices and documents (available on higher tiers).

built-for-africa.title: Built for Africa's Operators
